name: Pull request description
description: Drafts a pull request body from a title, a summary and how it was tested.
content:
Write a pull request description.

Title: {{title}}

Summary of the change:
{{summary}}

How it was tested:
{{testing_notes}}

Use these sections, in this order:
## What changed
A short paragraph and a bullet list of the main edits.
## Why
The problem this solves or the reason for the change.
## Testing
What was run and the result. State plainly anything that was not tested.
## Notes for reviewers
Risks, follow-ups or places to look first. Omit the section if there are none.

Keep it factual and short.

variables.name: testing_notes
variables.description: What was run and what passed
